summary: The Decider Store (Phase 1) — 13/13 backend tests PASS and admin frontend renders correctly. Verified: (a) PUBLIC no-auth routes GET /api/decider-store, /meta (contains 'Financial'), /bmp-55-patterns (10 factors × 54 options), /import-template.xlsx (spreadsheetml, ~non-empty); (b) admin-guarded routes return 401/403 without auth (list-all, import/excel); (c) admin import/excel with real Business_Model_Assessments.xlsx returns 10 factors + 54 options; (d) create → GET (public visibility) → PUT (factor classification persists) → authorize → DELETE → 404; (e) CLONE full → decision with 10 factors (category primary/mandatory) + 54 options + assessments with unit_value ('Solo, Startup (40%)') and percentage=null; (f) CLONE values_only → factors category='' and rating=0; (g) unauthenticated clone → 401/403; (h) paid template clone → 402 with price_paise+currency in detail. Admin frontend /admin/decider-store rendered via Admin Portal login (super@test.com): title, subtitle, three toolbar buttons (Excel template · Import Excel · Import Google Sheet), seeded 'The 55 Business Model Patterns' card as LIVE with 10 factors · 54 options · Free · 9 installs, Full clone + Values-only chips, and Classify/Unpublish/Delete action buttons all visible. Classify modal opens showing Mandatory/Optional segmented toggle + priority stepper per factor; Google Sheet modal opens with URL input.

issues: Console warnings (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'. These are RN Web deprecation warnings only.

action_items: (Optional / low-priority) Migrate deprecated RN web styles: replace 'shadow*' props with 'boxShadow' and stop using 'props.pointerEvents' (use style.pointerEvents) to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/decider_store.py cleanly orders admin routes (/admin/all, /meta, /import*) BEFORE the parametric /{template_id} public detail route so parameters can't shadow admin endpoints — good.
GET /{template_id} correctly returns 404 for non-public/unauthorized templates (does not leak pending templates).
Paid clone returns HTTP 402 with structured detail (price_paise, currency, creator_split_pct) — ready for Phase 2 payment wiring.
MongoDB _id is projected out via {"_id": 0} in public GETs and stripped from admin list — no ObjectId leak.
clone_template correctly builds a decision with clone_mode + source_template_id and increments install_count atomically.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (rendered + modals open; file-picker upload not automated per note)

seed_data_creation: Used the existing seeded 'bmp-55-patterns' template. Test suite creates TEST_BMP_iter188 and TEST_PAID_iter188 and deletes both in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_decider_store_iter188.py covers: PUBLIC list/meta/detail/xlsx (no auth), admin import/excel (admin OK, no-auth 401/403), create→get→update(factors)→authorize→delete round-trip, clone full/values-only prefill invariants, clone auth guard, and paid template 402. Uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Frontend admin screen verified visually via mobile-viewport (390x844) — the browser cannot upload a real file through DocumentPicker (native picker) so import is exercised via the backend test.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues. Two initial test failures were pytest artifacts: (1) reusing a logged-in requests.Session for 'unauth' assertions leaked cookies; fixed by using bare requests.post; (2) sending the full 500KB xlsx b64 with no auth intermittently returned 502 from the ingress — replaced with a minimal 'AA==' payload since only the auth guard was under test.
